items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: No, I don't know that name anymore. August Roussel.

ctx.x: I just had some questions. I was going to ask you about some of those fellows like August Roussel there. You remember him, trombone player?
No, I don't know that name anymore. August Roussel.
Oh, Roussel. I think I'm Roussel. Let me see.
